pictures.scene: Ferdinand Bol, Salomo ontvangt geschenken - the young king Solomon enthroned under a canopy while envoys kneel and lay out their gifts before him, the prayer that opens the psalm asking God to endow the king with His own justice
pictures.name: pd_bol_salomo_ontvangt_geschenken

pictures.scene: Jan de Bray, Regenten van het Sint-Lucasgilde - the governors of the guild seated in sober black around their table, weighing a case together, the son of the king asked to judge God's people with righteousness
pictures.name: pd_de_bray_regenten_sint_lucasgilde

pictures.scene: Friedrich Gauermann, Blick auf Liefering - a wide alpine valley at peace, cattle in the meadow and the mountains standing clear beyond, the mountains bringing peace to the people
pictures.name: pd_gauermann_blick_auf_liefering

pictures.scene: Gerbrand van den Eeckhout, De grootmoedigheid van Scipio - the conqueror handing the captive bride back to her betrothed instead of keeping her, the hills bringing righteousness and the afflicted among the people vindicated
pictures.name: pd_eeckhout_grootmoedigheid_van_scipio

pictures.scene: Marc Louis Benjamin Vautier, Children at the Table - poor children gathered round a plain table and fed, the children of the needy saved and the oppressor crushed
pictures.name: pd_vautier_kinder_am_tisch

pictures.scene: Frans Post, Gezicht op Olinda, Brazilie - a far country under a huge bright sky, the sun high over palms and distant roofs, the king feared as long as the sun shines and as long as the moon remains
pictures.name: pd_post_gezicht_op_olinda

pictures.scene: Julien Dupre, Fenaison - haymakers turning the fresh-cut grass in a wide summer field, the king like rain that falls on freshly cut grass
pictures.name: pd_julien_dupre_fenaison

pictures.scene: Daniel Ridgway Knight, After lunch, on the banks of the Seine - girls resting by the green river in the soft light after a shower, spring showers watering the earth and the righteous flourishing
pictures.name: pd_ridgway_knight_after_lunch_seine

pictures.scene: Cornelis Springer, Cathedral Square - a prosperous town square busy with trade under the cathedral's great tower, prosperity abounding until the moon is no more
pictures.name: pd_springer_kathedraal_plein

pictures.scene: Johan Hendrik Weissenbruch, Strandgezicht - the open sea meeting a low shore under a vast moving sky, the king ruling from sea to sea and to the ends of the earth
pictures.name: pd_weissenbruch_strandgezicht

pictures.scene: Leopold Carl Muller, Riders in the Desert - desert horsemen halted on the open sand, the nomads bowing before him and his enemies licking the dust
pictures.name: pd_muller_riders_in_the_desert

pictures.scene: Adam Willaerts, Ships off a Rocky Coast - tall ships of distant shores riding in close to land with their boats being unloaded, the kings of Tarshish and distant shores bringing tribute
pictures.name: pd_willaerts_ships_off_a_rocky_coast

pictures.scene: Jacques-Louis David, The Coronation of Napoleon - a whole assembly of rank bowed and standing before a crowning, all kings bowing down to him and all nations serving him
pictures.name: pd_david_coronation

pictures.scene: Aleksander Gierymski, Zydowka z pomaranczami - a poor old woman standing at the street corner with her basket of oranges, the needy who cry out and the afflicted who have no helper
pictures.name: pd_gierymski_zydowka_z_pomaranczami

pictures.scene: Otto van Veen, The Famished People after the Relief of the Siege of Leiden - bread handed down into the hands of the starving city, pity taken on the poor and needy and the lives of the oppressed saved
pictures.name: pd_van_veen_ontzet_van_leiden

pictures.scene: John Everett Millais, The Ransom - a father counting out jewels and gold to armed men to buy his children back, redeeming them from oppression and violence because their blood is precious in his sight
pictures.name: pd_millais_the_ransom

pictures.scene: Otto Eerelman, Het Frederiksplein te Amsterdam tijdens de intocht van koningin Wilhelmina - a crowd filling the square with flags and cheers as the young queen rides in, Long may he live
pictures.name: pd_eerelman_intocht_wilhelmina

pictures.scene: Gerrit Dou, Een kluizenaar in gebed - a hermit kneeling alone at his open book with hands folded, people praying for the king and blessing him all day long
pictures.name: pd_dou_kluizenaar_in_gebed

pictures.scene: Hendrik Valkenburg, Korenschoven - sheaves of corn standing thick in the stubble with the gleaners among them, an abundance of grain in the land swaying atop the hills
pictures.name: pd_valkenburg_korenschoven

pictures.scene: Gustave Courbet, Gezicht in het bos van Fontainebleau - great trees crowding a forest clearing in full leaf, fruit trees flourishing like the forests of Lebanon and the people like the grass of the field
pictures.name: pd_courbet_bos_van_fontainebleau

pictures.scene: Carl Agricola, Athen nach Sonnenaufgang - the ancient city lit by the risen sun, its old stones still standing, the king's name enduring forever and continuing as long as the sun shines
pictures.name: pd_agricola_athen_nach_sonnenaufgang

pictures.scene: Duccio di Buoninsegna, Christ and the Samaritan Woman - Christ at the well speaking with the foreign woman while the disciples come up behind, all nations blessed in him and calling him blessed
pictures.name: pd_duccio_christus_en_de_samaritaanse

pictures.scene: Francis Danby, Le Christ marchant sur les eaux - Christ standing on the night sea with His hand out to the sinking Peter, the boat and its lantern beyond, blessed be the LORD God of Israel who alone does marvelous deeds
pictures.name: pd_danby_christus_op_de_zee

pictures.scene: Theodore Rousseau, Sunset near Arbonne - the sun breaking through banked golden cloud and flooding the whole plain with light, His glorious name blessed forever and all the earth filled with His glory
pictures.name: pd_rousseau_zonsondergang_bij_arbonne

pictures.scene: Isidor Kaufmann, Portrait of a Sephardic Jew - a bearded man of Israel holding his small prayer book closed in both hands, the prayers of David son of Jesse concluded, Amen and amen
pictures.name: pd_kaufmann_portret_sefardische_jood

lines: Of Solomon.
Endow the king with Your justice, O God,
and the son of the king with Your righteousness.
May he judge Your people with righteousness
and Your afflicted with justice.
May the mountains bring peace to the people,
and the hills bring righteousness.
May he vindicate the afflicted among the people;
may he save the children of the needy
and crush the oppressor.
May they fear him as long as the sun shines,
as long as the moon remains,
through all generations.
May he be like rain that falls on freshly cut grass,
like spring showers that water the earth.
May the righteous flourish in his days
and prosperity abound
until the moon is no more.
May he rule from sea to sea,
and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.
May the nomads bow before him,
and his enemies lick the dust.
May the kings of Tarshish and distant shores bring tribute;
may the kings of Sheba and Seba offer gifts.
May all kings bow down to him
and all nations serve him.
For he will deliver the needy who cry out
and the afflicted who have no helper.
He will take pity on the poor and needy
and save the lives of the oppressed.
He will redeem them from oppression and violence,
for their blood is precious in his sight.
Long may he live!
May gold from Sheba be given him.
May people ever pray for him;
may they bless him all day long.
May there be an abundance of grain in the land;
may it sway atop the hills.
May its fruit trees flourish like the forests of Lebanon,
the people of its cities like the grass of the field.
May his name endure forever;
may his name continue as long as the sun shines.
In him may all nations be blessed;
may they call him blessed.
Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel,
who alone does marvelous deeds.
And blessed be His glorious name forever;
may all the earth be filled with His glory.
Amen and amen.
Thus conclude the prayers of David son of Jesse.
